_note: Illustrative INPUT messages written by the TEKMĒ developer for demonstration. They are not from any dataset and carry no stored predictions; every result shown in the UI is computed live. Links use reserved, non-resolvable domains (.example) and phone numbers are fictitious.

examples.title: Fake KYC warning
examples.text: Dear SBI customer, your KYC has expired and your account will be blocked within 24 hours. Update immediately: http://sbi-kyc-verify.example/login

examples.title: Genuine OTP
examples.text: 483921 is your OTP for login to NetBanking. Valid for 5 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone. Bank staff will never ask for it.

examples.title: OTP-sharing trap
examples.text: Your account will be suspended today. To stop this, send the OTP 483921 you just received to our agent at 9876543210.

examples.title: Bank debit alert
examples.text: Rs.2,450.00 debited from A/c XX4821 on 21-Nov to VPA foodapp@icici. Avl Bal Rs.18,302.11. If not done by you, call the number on the back of your card.

examples.title: Hinglish KYC scam
examples.text: Aapka SBI khata aaj band ho jayega. Turant KYC update karein warna account block: http://kyc-update.example/sbi

examples.title: Hindi (Devanagari) scam
examples.text: आपका बैंक खाता आज बंद हो जाएगा। तुरंत केवाईसी अपडेट करें: http://kyc-verify.example

examples.title: Obfuscated KYC scam
examples.text: Y0ur acc0unt is bl0cked. Upd8 ur K Y C n0w at bit.ly/kyc-upd8 to av0id suspensi0n!!

examples.title: Lottery / prize
examples.text: Congratulations! Your number has won Rs 25,00,000 in the KBC Lucky Draw. Pay Rs 4,999 processing fee to claim your prize. WhatsApp +91 98765 43210

examples.title: Part-time job
examples.text: Part-time job offer! Earn Rs 3000-8000 daily by liking YouTube videos. No experience needed. Contact HR on WhatsApp: wa.me/919876543210

examples.title: Instant loan
examples.text: Pre-approved instant loan of Rs 5,00,000 at 0% interest! No documents, no CIBIL check. Pay Rs 1,999 file charge to get the money in 10 minutes.

examples.title: Parcel customs fee
examples.text: India Post: Your parcel is held at customs. Pay Rs 49 release fee within 12 hours at http://indiapost-redelivery.example or it will be returned.

examples.title: Order shipped
examples.text: Your Amazon order #405-7788123 has been shipped and will be delivered tomorrow. Track it at amazon.in/your-orders

examples.title: Personal chat
examples.text: Hey, reached home safely. Let's meet for lunch tomorrow at 1?

examples.title: Appointment reminder
examples.text: Reminder: your appointment with Dr. Mehta is confirmed for Tue 25 Nov at 10:30 AM. Reply C to cancel.
